searchText: I think ronin's validator had to resync, it's ~700k blocks behind on https://stats.goerli.net so hopefully will break the deadlock when it comes back online more of a reason to merge that soon 😄 It would be kind of nice to figure out a tweak to Clique that makes this problem less likely There is a known solution, and it has an EIP proposed to fix it. However, with clique going away with The Merge, it was decided it wasn't worth implementing. Oh I didn't know that! I'm interested, where is it? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3436 OK, but it was rejected in ACD? <@403707149043105803> Lobbied for it in ACD a bit, and I don't think anyone thought it was a bad idea. The problem was just that no one wanted to put in the effort to code it because Clique is very close to EOL. I don't think it has limited lifespan There is always 'institutional use' Like, lots of people have private networks with Clique The current plan is to that it won't be maintained post-merge, since you can achieve the same thing with PoS, which will be actively maintained. And people don't want to maintain PoA and PoS at the same time, since PoS can be used as PoA. Yes, but for PoS to work you need a beacon chain deployed. And deposits, etc. IMHO there are valid use cases for PoA after the merge PoA is the best That aren't solved by something like spaceneth/dev made? Pretty much all testing scenarios I think are solved better with dev/spaceneth like mode. And PoS for public testnets. That leaves the set of use cases to people who don't want to setup full PoS, but also are doing something more than just testing. The problem with Spaceneth is, it cannot be used in an Internet-facing setting I do agree that there are some people who would use/benefit from PoA. The question I think is whether that set of people is large enough to warrant maintaining clique in all of the clients. It's very easy to set up a new PoA testnet now It takes 5 minutes, and the security of it will be very strong (And it will be a permissioned network) I kind of want to preserve that Anyway, I didn't know Danno had already looked into it with this EIP I'm not convinced it is worth the effort of core devs to maintain that, but I could maybe be convinced. My original question is resolved now This bug is definitely solvable. In case it does not have to be a clique network: Besu offers two alternative production ready PoA consensus algorithms, IBFT2 and QBFT. The appeal of Clique is that it's already implemented in many clients. IBFT2 is pretty complex AFAIK Doesn't it require additional networking even? Implementing 3436 in Geth or nethermind should prevent Goreli from spontaneously halting. Only half the clients need to follow the same fork choice rule, and adding one more client to the list supporitng 3436 should get the majority of goerli on it. I think QBFT would be a better choice over IBFT2, because Quorum also supports it making it multi-client. But there is a different set of networking calls needed to keep a BFT consensus moving forward, the consensus nodes are a bit more tightly coupled. there is always AuRa, but with OE going out, only Nethermind really supports it now. I would also like to fix Clique, but its very hard to prioritize that. AuRa has its own drawbacks though
